subject: sounds
title: Tricky spellings
about: Some spellings make two different sounds: s in sun or zoo, c in cat or city, g in goat or gem, th in thin or this, oo in moon or book, n in nut or pink. CKLA calls these tricky spellings and teaches them from Unit 1 (th, s) through Units 5 and 6 (c, g, n).
tip: Ask him to try the word both ways and pick the one that makes a real word.

cards.q: In the word dogs, what sound does the letter s make?
cards.note: s can say the sound in sun or the sound in zoo. In dogs it says the zoo sound.
